turn_boundaries.speaker: host_1
turn_boundaries.text: Students frequently mix up mirror formulas and lens formulas during timed exams. Alex, what's the key distinction?

turn_boundaries.speaker: host_2
turn_boundaries.text: The minus signs swap! The mirror formula has a plus sign (1/v + 1/u), but the lens formula has a minus sign (1/v - 1/u). And for magnification, lenses use positive v over u!

turn_boundaries.speaker: host_1
turn_boundaries.text: Perfect memory rule! Keeping that sign swap clear prevents easy numerical mistakes.
